Name: Camshaft adjustment
Comment: Packed command bits, not cam degrees. AT warm bits 0/1, AT cold 2/3, MT warm 4/5, MT cold 6/7. Prior OFF selects the lower bit, prior ON the upper. Pair 00=OFF, 10=hold, 11=ON, 01=toggles. No interpolation of states. Display uses RPM axis 0. Actual selector 0x8fdb.bits1:0 selects axes 0,1,2,3. RPM node addresses: 0x4c19, 0x4c25, 0x4c31, 0x4c3d. Hexadecimal display in CSV, XDF and KP: FF=255, CF=207, EF=239. For MT warm only, FF to CF requests OFF, FF to EF holds, preserving other bits. ON/OFF denotes software command, not measured cam angle. Enable and diagnostic conditions still apply.

Comment: Upper MAF reading threshold for airflow plausibility diagnosis. If an excess is confirmed, the ECU can substitute measured airflow with the Engine Load Model.
